user.title: Add a Zyxel switch
user.description: Connect to a supported Zyxel GS1200 or GS1900 switch. GS1900 monitoring requires read-only SNMPv2c access.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname. A complete http:// or https:// URL is also accepted.
data_description.snmp_community: Required for GS1900 monitoring. Leave blank for GS1200.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Zyxel switch
reconfigure.description: Update the management address, protocol or credentials. Leave secret fields blank to keep their existing values.

data_description.password: Leave blank to keep the stored password.
data_description.snmp_community: Leave blank to keep the stored community.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Zyxel switch
reauth_confirm.description: Enter replacement web-interface credentials. Leave the password blank to retain the stored password.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the switch.
error.invalid_auth: The switch rejected the supplied credentials.
error.session_busy: The switch web interface is already in use. Log out of other browser sessions and try again.
error.unsupported: The device did not identify as a supported Zyxel GS1200 or GS1900 switch.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Check the Home Assistant log for details.

abort.wrong_device: The replacement address belongs to a different physical switch.

init.title: Zyxel Switch options
init.description: Choose how frequently Home Assistant polls the switch.

action_failed.message: The switch rejected the requested change: {error}
